candidate_sentences.text: JLT Mobile Computers reported net sales of SEK 131.5 million for the fiscal year 2025, representing an 11.1 percent increase from the SEK 118.4 million recorded in the previous year.
This top-line growth was driven by a robust order intake of SEK 141.6 million, a 37.5 percent rise compared to the prior period.
Consequently, the operating loss narrowed significantly to SEK -1.9 million, a substantial improvement from the SEK -9.7 million loss reported in 2024.

The company’s cash flow from operating activities turned positive at SEK 3.7 million, compared to SEK 6.8 million in the previous year, largely due to a strategic reduction in inventory.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operational impact of external challenges: geopolitical uncertainty suppressed demand in the largest segment (warehousing and logistics), a ~20% depreciation of the US dollar against the Swedish krona (affecting 74% of sales and gross margin), and customs duties on non-European components increased administrative costs and burden.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO letter (page 5-6) explicitly details geopolitical uncertainty, weak demand in logistics, currency effects (USD lost almost 20% against SEK), and customs duty impacts on inventory valuation and administrative workload.

candidate_sentences.text: However, the company’s profitability was negatively impacted by significant currency fluctuations.

Since 74 percent of JLT’s sales were invoiced in dollars, this devaluation reduced the gross margin to 38.3 percent from 45.8 percent in 2024, a decrease of 7.5 percentage points.

The company’s strategic diversification away from its largest segment, warehousing and logistics, which remained subdued due to geopolitical uncertainty, positions it to capture growth in markets with larger investment budgets.
